title: Add GitHub issue intake and approval gates
description: Make GitHub Issues the public request queue, document the maintainer approval policy, and enforce issue-linked pull requests before merge.
acceptance_criteria: Contributors can submit structured bug reports and feature requests through GitHub Issue Forms.
Only issues explicitly labelled ready-for-development are eligible for agent implementation.
Pull requests must link an approved issue and pass repository checks before merge.
The default branch requires a reviewed pull request and passing CI.
